name: Vercel
description: Your Vercel projects and their deployments, and a failed build's log, with an access token of yours.

preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Make one at vercel.com › Account Settings › Tokens, its scope Full Account (or the one team you want). Vercel's tokens can't be made read-only: this one is only read with, and only sent to api.vercel.com.

preferences.title: Team
preferences.description: A team's slug (as in its dashboard's address) or ID (in its Settings › General). Without it, your personal account, or the team a token's own scope is.
